Compare map_version and allocation_id, then trace the two changed paths through the lookup. Mark mismatched or absent provenance as insufficient evidence instead of inventing a physical placement.
Against the nominal LUMI-G: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Apply a teaching budget of 20 cost units: the nominal assignment passes and the changed one fails. A production choice would additionally require traffic sizes, contention measurements and the actual allocation topology.
Reverify this criterion: List all eight contributions and verify totals of 16 and 30. Shuffle row order and replace display labels while preserving keys; correct lookup semantics must make the result invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。成本突然上升可能是綁定錯誤，也可能是兩張不同版本的對照表混用；檢查 map_version 與 allocation_id，追蹤變動的兩條路徑；缺少版本即列資料不足。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An apparent cost increase may come from wrong bindings or from joining topology and allocation files from different versions. Neither explanation can be resolved using only the final scalar total. Compare map_version and allocation_id, then trace the two changed paths through the lookup. Mark mismatched or absent provenance as insufficient evidence instead of inventing a physical placement.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 列出八個成本分項，總量 16 或 30；以裝置名稱重排測試，結果不能依列順序改變；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: List all eight contributions and verify totals of 16 and 30. Shuffle row order and replace display labels while preserving keys; correct lookup semantics must make the result invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 把裝置到 NUMA 的映射視為查表函數，再對每條等量傳輸累加教學成本；成本單位是模型權重而非量測奈秒。
knowledge.textEn: Treat device-to-NUMA placement as an explicit lookup, then sum the assigned costs of equal-sized transfers. Model cost units are pedagogical weights, not measured nanoseconds or a linear performance prediction.

steps.title: LUMI-G：建立可追溯輸入與所有權 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: LUMI-G: construct traceable inputs and ownership · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「LUMI-G：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for LUMI-G: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付排列矩陣、成本分解、版本檢查及一份順序打亂後仍相同的驗證結果；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-003 --out ./hpc-a-003-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
在交接件中加入「LUMI-G：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：列出八個成本分項，總量 16 或 30；以裝置名稱重排測試，結果不能依列順序改變；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：產生 mapping.csv、assignment.csv、costs.csv；要求裝置鍵唯一，每個配置必須引用存在的 NUMA 節點。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the permutation table, per-transfer cost breakdown, provenance checks and a shuffled-input regression. Explain exactly why matching device numbers are not an acceptable replacement for the lookup. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-003 --out ./hpc-a-003-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for LUMI-G: construct traceable inputs and ownership: List all eight contributions and verify totals of 16 and 30. Shuffle row order and replace display labels while preserving keys; correct lookup semantics must make the result invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Create mapping.csv, assignment.csv and costs.csv. Enforce unique device keys and existing NUMA references, then materialize a joined row for every transfer before performing arithmetic. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。列出八個成本分項，總量 16 或 30；以裝置名稱重排測試，結果不能依列順序改變；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. List all eight contributions and verify totals of 16 and 30. Shuffle row order and replace display labels while preserving keys; correct lookup semantics must make the result invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: List all eight contributions and verify totals of 16 and 30. Shuffle row order and replace display labels while preserving keys; correct lookup semantics must make the result invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
